name: 粉もん屋 八 奈良餅飯殿店 (Konamonya Hachi Nara Mochiidono)

claims.text: Takoyaki batter is wheat flour cooked on shared iron griddle plates; no gluten-free preparation is offered.
Standard finishing sauce on takoyaki is a wheat-based takoyaki/okonomiyaki-style sauce; no allergen labeling is provided.
Batter is made with a fish-based broth and the dish features octopus and typically egg, with bonito flakes and mayonnaise as common toppings.
The shop's production centers on wheat-flour cookies, icing cookies, and baked sweets, so a flour-heavy environment makes cross-contamination likely; no gluten-free handling is documented.
Baked goods are butter cookies and焼き菓子 typically containing dairy and eggs; no dairy-free or egg-free line is advertised, so vegan visitors should ask item by item.
The loose-leaf Chinese and Taiwanese teas are naturally plant-based and gluten-free and can be bought separately from the baked goods.
